from solution import encode_csv_field as f
for a,b in [('plain','plain'),('a,"b','"a,""b"'),('a\nb','"a\nb"'),('a\rb','"a\rb"'),('"','""""')]: assert f(a)==b,(a,f(a))

prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.py.
Required API: def encode_csv_field(value: str) -> str
Behavior: Serialize one RFC-4180-style field. Return it unchanged unless it contains comma, double quote, CR, or LF; then surround it with double quotes and double every embedded double quote.
Visible example: The value a,"b becomes "a,""b" (including the surrounding quotes).

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

known_bad.code:
def encode_csv_field(value: str) -> str:
    return '"'+value+'"' if ',' in value else value
known_bad.label: quotes-only-commas

reference.code:
def encode_csv_field(value: str) -> str:
    return '"'+value.replace('"','""')+'"' if any(c in value for c in ',"\r\n') else value
reference.label: author-reference
